start: A gym member with workouts logged last month, on Profile

steps.action: On Profile, tap last month's report row
user_sees: Screen titled with the month (for example 'October 2026'), subtitle 'Monthly report'
Month arrows with the month names before and after
Headline numbers, coach note, change against the month before, days trained, records, muscles, favourite exercises
must_not: Figures from another month
A send (share) button missing when the month has workouts

steps.action: Tap the share button ('Share as a picture')
user_sees: Sheet 'Share as a picture' with the picture, 'Picture size', 'Picture background', 'Your gym on the picture' and button 'Share picture'
must_not: Body weight, or a figure that divides back to it, on the picture
The member's name or phone number on the picture

steps.action: Tap 'Share picture' and pick WhatsApp
user_sees: The phone's share menu with a PNG of the report
must_not: Two share menus from one tap
A broken or blank picture

steps.action: Close the sheet, tap 'Share as text'
user_sees: The phone's share menu with the month as plain text ('Paste it into any AI chat for advice')
must_not: Text for a different month

start: A gym member in a later year, on Profile

steps.action: Tap the year row (for example '150 workouts in 2025')
user_sees: Title '2025 in review', subtitle 'Year in review'
Year arrows '2024' and '2026'
must_not: Month figures shown under a year title

steps.action: Open the current year
user_sees: Title '<year> so far'
must_not: 'in review' for a year that is not over

steps.action: Tap the share button
user_sees: Year picture in 'Share as a picture'
must_not: Body weight on the year picture although the year page shows a body weight line

start: A gym member on a monthly report

steps.action: Tap the left arrow
user_sees: The month before
must_not: The arrow working before the first month with a workout (it is greyed out there)

steps.action: Tap the right arrow until this month
user_sees: This month; the right arrow greyed out
must_not: A future month opening by the arrow

steps.action: Tap 'See all' on the month's records
user_sees: Records screen with ' in <Month YYYY>' and only that month's records
must_not: Records from other months

steps.action: Tap a favourite exercise
user_sees: That exercise's page
must_not: A different exercise

start: A gym member opening a month with no workouts, or a report that fails to load

steps.action: Open a past month with no workouts
user_sees: 'No workouts in <Month>' with 'Nothing was logged that month.'
No share button
must_not: A share picture of zeros
'KG LIFTED 0'

steps.action: Open this month before any workout
user_sees: 'No workouts yet this month' with 'Workouts you log this month will show here.'
must_not: 'Nothing was logged that month.' for a month still running

steps.action: Open a report whose read fails
user_sees: 'Couldn't load this report' with a try-again button
must_not: An endless grey loading block

steps.action: Open the report link with a broken period (for example 'abc')
user_sees: This month's report
must_not: A crash or a blank screen

start: A gym member on this month's report, month running

steps.action: Look at this month
user_sees: Title is the month, figures 'so far'
must_not: The month called complete

steps.action: Log a workout, come back to the report
user_sees: The new workout counted in the totals and days trained
must_not: Old totals until the app restarts

steps.action: Delete that workout, come back
user_sees: Totals go down again
must_not: The deleted workout still counted

steps.action: On the 1st of next month, open last month
user_sees: 'No workouts in' wording if empty, or full figures, now complete
must_not: 'so far' wording on a finished month

start: A gym member about to share a report picture

steps.action: Open 'Share as a picture'
user_sees: Only workout figures; a switch 'Your gym on the picture'
must_not: Body weight, measurements, photos, name or phone number on the picture

steps.action: Turn 'Your gym on the picture' off and share
user_sees: Picture with no gym logo or name
must_not: The gym's logo still on the picture

steps.action: Share as text to an AI app
user_sees: Workout summary text only
must_not: Body weight or notes in the text
